In [[188 BBY]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Kibh Jeen]] fell to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and raised an '''army''' of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], which he used to wage war against the inhabitants of the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. The [[Army/Legends|army]] operated from the [[Cularin asteroid belt]] and under Jeen's direction, they launched a [[Battle of Genarius (Dark Jedi Conflict)|bloody attack]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]], which triggered a war that became known as the "[[Dark Jedi Conflict]]." The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] eventually dispatched two Jedi to the Cularin [[Star system/Legends|system]] in [[181 BBY/Legends|181 BBY]], to bring the conflict to a resolution. The Jedi lured Jeen's army into a trap and after a [[Final battle of the Dark Jedi Conflict|fiercely-fought space battle]], the pirates were defeated.
